### [Practitioner Exchange](practitioner-exchange.qmd)

For practitioners who want to lead groups with more confidence. Each
participant leads a session in their own practice and gets feedback from the
group.

Tentatively May 2027 · three days · Germany · in English
:::

::: {.item}
### [Moving Together](moving-together.qmd)

A movement retreat for anyone: yoga, tantra and improvised movement, alone, in
pairs and as a whole group. No experience needed.

Tentatively September 2027 · three days · Germany · in English
:::
